answer.text: When a source is hidden, the checks that relied on it lose their supporting evidence. In this assessment, hiding the paper changed two check statuses: documented-framework and target-observed both dropped from supported to unknown. A third check, trial-endpoint, also lost an evidence item but its status did not change because it was already unknown before the source was hidden. The overall outcome stayed at needs_information throughout. In plain terms, the assessment no longer has recorded evidence that the selected framework is documented or that it has been used in SYNGAP1-related disorder. Those two questions now need to be re-established before planning can move forward. Suitability, permissions and feasibility require expert review.
